name: manual_0b0835
claim: Detected trust changes or genuine resolver outages must refuse the current security-sensitive operation even if a subsequent lookup recovers. Bind verification reuse to exact bytes, key identifiers and sampled public-key trust; preserve not-found semantics separately from resolver failures.

decisions.notes: Closure K1 real-signature regressions reproduced transient prewarm, warm-cache and refresh recovery into allow; d79182a and 7cb054f preserve specific unavailable refusals.

rationale: Closure K1 real-signature regressions reproduced transient prewarm, warm-cache and refresh recovery into allow; d79182a and 7cb054f preserve specific unavailable refusals.
